file: 08- Data Analysis and Reporting Techniques Using.docx
title: Data Analysis and Reporting Techniques Using Excel
overview: Excel is an indispensable tool for accountants, finance professionals, and business specialists. In today’s data-driven world, professionals face an overwhelming amount of unstructured information. This hands-on course is designed to elevate your skills in data preparation, modeling, integration, and automation using Excel.

From managing noisy and unstructured data to producing professional reports and performing in-depth analysis, this course will enhance your expertise and enable you to create impactful dashboards, scorecards, and reports. By mastering advanced Excel techniques, you will add immediate value to your role and organization.
audience: This course is ideal for professionals in business, finance, and accounting, including:
Anyone seeking to enhance their business reporting, reconciliation, and analysis skills using Excel.
methodology: This course is highly interactive, with 80% of the content focused on hands-on practice using MS Excel. Participants will complete group and individual exercises, case studies, and projects daily, while the remaining 20% emphasizes design and structure.
competencies: Integrating Excel with external data sources
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Develop advanced Excel Business Intelligence (BI) skills for business and management reporting.
Dynamically link Excel with PowerPoint for seamless data updates.
Create dynamic BI dashboards, scorecards, and flash reports to support performance measurement and decision-making.
Apply data analysis techniques to produce accurate, timely reports.
